open_points.subject: delivery_store state-folder traversal
open_points.text:
atomic writing of one file, and creating the missing folders below the binary store and the state
  folder, which the installation creates;
open_points.question: When a component below the state folder already exists as a symbolic link or another non-directory object, must delivery_store refuse it, follow an in-tree link, or follow any link while creating or opening lock and record paths?
options: Refuse every symbolic link or non-directory component below the state folder
Allow symbolic links only when their resolved targets remain below the state folder
Follow existing symbolic links without a containment check
open_points.default_guess: Refuse every symbolic link or non-directory component below the state folder and return state_unavailable when this prevents opening the project lock.

witness.initial: The state folder exists, but the would-be project subfolder is a symbolic link to a writable directory outside the state folder; no lock file or placement record exists at the resulting addresses.
events: A caller asks to deliver a new photo for that project.
delivery_store traverses the state path to create or open the project lock and later the placement record.
outcomes: An implementation follows the parent link, writes the lock and record outside the state folder, and the delivery succeeds.
An implementation refuses the linked parent component, writes nothing, and answers state_unavailable because it cannot open the project lock.
witness.observer: The caller sees success versus refusal, and the operator sees whether files appear outside the configured state folder.
